boundary: Schema-only observed parent lineage; all runtime records and controls must be synthetic. No live data/login/activation SQL.

indexes.name: parent_one_snap_controlled_test
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX parent_one_snap_controlled_test ON parent_private.snap_controlled_tests USING btree (enabled) WHERE enabled

indexes.name: snap_controlled_tests_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX snap_controlled_tests_pkey ON parent_private.snap_controlled_tests USING btree (request_id)

triggers.name: parent_snap_test_authorization
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER parent_snap_test_authorization BEFORE INSERT ON parent_private.snap_final_packet_authorizations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION parent_private.guard_snap_test_authorization()

triggers.name: parent_snap_test_outcome
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER parent_snap_test_outcome BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON parent_operations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION parent_private.guard_snap_test_outcome()

triggers.name: parent_preserve_snap_test_request
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER parent_preserve_snap_test_request BEFORE UPDATE ON parent_requests FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION parent_private.preserve_snap_test_request()

constraints.name: snap_controlled_tests_owner_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (owner_id) REFERENCES parent_accounts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: snap_controlled_tests_request_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (request_id) REFERENCES parent_requests(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: snap_controlled_tests_snapshot_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (snapshot_id) REFERENCES parent_snap_application_details(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
